signals.text: 3 new PM roles posted this week

bullets: Partner with the Executive Team to define and communicate a compelling product vision and strategy aligned with Tenna’s business goals, market opportunities, and customer needs.
Translate long-term product strategy into clear roadmaps, priorities, timelines, and executable plans for product, design, engineering, and other cross-functional teams.
Lead, and develop multiple and distributed product teams.
Maintain close visibility into product development, regularly reviewing progress, identifying risks, removing blockers, and ensuring teams deliver against commitments.
Oversee the development and evolution of Tenna’s web, native mobile, SaaS, and hardware-enabled product offerings.
Lead, coach, and develop the Product team, establishing clear expectations and creating accountability for results.
Turn product goals and business priorities into clear roadmaps, requirements, timelines, and executable plans
Partner with Software Engineering, Hardware, Design, and other cross-functional stakeholders to develop coordinated solutions across products.
Communicate product priorities, performance, risks, dependencies, and delivery timelines clearly to executives and cross-functional leaders.
Synthesize customer feedback, product usage data, market insights, and business needs into informed product decisions.
Leads and manages the entire feature and product lifecycle from planning, development, and launch.
Manages the iterative lifecycle of our product from idea conception to production including scope, defining specifications, prioritization, design, implementation, user acceptance…

Creates product specifications as needed: wireframes with support from Design, process workflows, state transition diagrams, copy decks, acceptance test plans, user stories and…
Defines and prioritizes the product backlog translating high-level requirements into user stories, and performs acceptance testing on a rolling basis throughout each product…
